summary_en: Momo no Ki, current 22.38% shareholder, to launch tender offer for 1,665,000 CAPITA shares (20.25% S/O) held by KMO Capital LLP. Tender offer period: Aug 14–Sep 10, 2026 (20 business days). Tender price not disclosed in announcement. KMO is CAPITA's second-largest shareholder; CAPITA director Kitabe Sota serves as KMO member.
title_en: Notification of Commencement of Tender Offer for Shares of CAPITA Inc. (Securities Code: 7462) by Momo no Ki Inc.
translation_en_brief: On 13 August 2026, Momo no Ki Inc., a restaurant operator established in December 2007 and current 22.38% shareholder of CAPITA Inc., announced the launch of a tender offer for ordinary shares of CAPITA (TSE Standard Market, code 7462). The tender offer targets 1,665,000 shares held by KMO Capital LLP (20.25% of S/O), CAPITA's second-largest shareholder. Momo no Ki and KMO entered into a tender offer application agreement on 13 August 2026, with KMO agreeing to tender all of its shares in the offer. The tender period runs from 14 August to 10 September 2026 (20 business days). The tender price has not been disclosed in this announcement. CAPITA director Kitabe Sota holds membership in KMO; aside from this overlap and KMO's shareholding, no other business or personal relationships exist between the parties. The announcement is filed under Financial Instruments and Exchange Act Article 30(1)(4) at CAPITA's request.
